messages:
nora: quick sync 94 final pass on KMS + region UI in retention settings. main focus: copy clarity, keyboard flow, audit hooks.

ben: flagged: modal currently shows 'Exportable' under BYOK. legal says avoid assertive export claims. Suggest 'Export depends on your KMS policy.'

sami: a11y: when the extra details expand, focus should move into the content. use aria-expanded and focus management. also the region dropdown should announce the full country name, not code.

claire: UX: hide 'No encryption' for orgs with policy enforce_encryption=true. if shown disabled, tooltip: 'Disabled by org policy: encryption required.'

audit-bot: pro tip: emit event audit.kms.region.update.v1 with fields previous_kms, previous_region, user_id, request_id. alias legacy audit.kms.change for 90d.

ben: copy candidates: 'Redwood-managed (recommended): Redwood stores and rotates keys; Redwood does not provide access to key material.' / 'Customer-managed (BYOK): Use your KMS. Export and rotation depend on your KMS policy. Requires KMS admin.'

sami: keyboard order: 1) KMS radios, 2) explainer expander (collapsed), 3) region select (full name), 4) Save.

claire: visual: replace tiny 'BYOK' badge with an inline chip 'Customer-managed (BYOK) 97 requires KMS admin' and ensure --color-warning-600 + --color-on-warning meet AA.

nora: final action list: 1) adopt ben's safe copy, 2) implement aria focus trap + order per sami, 3) hide/disable No encryption based on policy per claire, 4) emit audit event + alias per audit-bot. I'll assemble PR and attach keyboard prototype.

ben: thanks 94 I'll sanity-check copy with legal and post final strings.

sami: I'll add the a11y test checklist for QA.

nora: closing 94 will ping when PR is ready. :thumbsup:
